# AWS Data Processing Terms (demo mirror)

Illustrative content for the Night's Watch hackathon demo. Not AWS's actual terms.

Last updated: 2026-06-01

## Scope

These terms describe how AWS processes customer data on behalf of its customers when providing cloud hosting and infrastructure services.

## Use of customer data

We process customer data only to provide, maintain and secure the services. We do not use customer data to train machine learning or AI models.

## Retention

Customer data is deleted within 30 days of account termination. Tax and invoice records are retained for 7 years as required by law.

## Security

Customer data is encrypted in transit and at rest, and access is limited to authorized personnel. We train our support staff on data protection every year.

## Changes to sub-processors

We notify customers at least 30 days before adding a new sub-processor. Customers may object to a new sub-processor during the notice period.
